summary: Backend testing of multi-line procurement requests (/api/procurement/*) — 16/16 PASSED. All target scenarios verified: multi-line create with items[], catalog auto-fill (name/category/unit/unitPrice), supplier auto-fill from first component, empty items[] fallback to legacy, manual items without componentId, legacy single-line still works, PUT replaces items+recomputes totalPrice (clears single-line scalars), PUT without items preserves existing multi-line, PUT legacy single-line recomputes via qty*price, GET returns both shapes with isOverdue decoration, multi-line Telegram HTML format includes positions list + Итого, single-line keeps Кол-во format, regression on /stats, /components, /components/quick-create.

minor.issue: When `items` is included but empty list ([]) in PUT body, body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) keeps key, but update dict filters out `None` only — `items=[]` is kept and would replace existing items with []. This is the documented behavior, but FE should never PATCH-style send items=[] when intending to keep existing. No bug — flagged for awareness.

critical_code_review_comments: _normalize_items autofill: per-line unit/category/name fallback only fills when body value is empty string/None — correct. unitPrice is only autofilled when `not float(line.get('unitPrice') or 0)` — meaning 0.0 is treated as 'empty'. FE should be aware: if user intentionally sets price=0, catalog price will override.

PUT branch: `if 'items' in update` triggers only when client explicitly sent the key (exclude_unset=True). Sending `items: null` is filtered by `v is not None` guard — preserves existing items (good). Sending `items: []` replaces with empty list AND clears single-line scalars only when norm_items is truthy — so empty items array leaves quantity/unitPrice untouched but totalPrice becomes 0. Slight inconsistency: legacy single-line recompute is in the else-branch, so PUT items=[] will NOT recompute totalPrice from qty/price (sets it to 0). FE should avoid sending items=[] for legacy update.
create_request multi-line: doc.componentId set to None, but componentName/category/unit set to empty strings — list_requests sort key uses dueDate fallback ok. No effect on isOverdue.
Telegram multi-line message truncates at 10 lines and adds '… и ещё N поз.' — good. Each line uses {price:.2f} which works for ints/floats.
Idempotency notifications.created flag set only on TG send — in preview without TG creds, multi-line creates flag stays False. Same caveat as iteration_104 — flag attempts vs flag success trade-off.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed procurement_requests and TEST_MULTI_/TEST_REG_ sauna_components; teardown deletes requests via DELETE endpoint. Leftover TEST_ components (no public DELETE endpoint) cleaned via direct Mongo after run. Verified 0 TEST_ procurement_requests and 0 TEST_ sauna_components remain.
